text: Model-based yes/no gate (Jev-style): add when an open-source variant runs locally, or after two logged incidents the plain checks missed
Dispatch helper: one command that creates the dev-based worktree, the handshake stub and the filled builder brief for a task
Stop zip merge conflicts: builders' branches always conflict on the committed zips; consider a merge driver or building zips only at release commits
Maturation pass before v0.3.1: the gate is now a large static shell reader and the suite more than doubled; prune and simplify using alpha usage evidence before adding anything
Hard layer under the gate: evaluate Claude Code sandbox / permission deny rules for the protected tree, since the gate's evasion resistance is not independently verified
